name: FADD-related Immunodeficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the FADD gene
Reduced or absent FADD protein expression in lymphocytes by flow cytometry or western blot
Early-onset severe immunodeficiency with recurrent bacterial and viral infections
Impaired Fas-mediated lymphocyte apoptosis demonstrated in functional assays

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic pathogenic FADD variants plus clinical immunodeficiency and reduced FADD protein expression
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on genetic testing combined with immunological and clinical findings.

laboratory: Elevated serum IgM with low IgG and IgA
imaging: Lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly on ultrasound or CT
Bronchiectasis on chest CT in chronic pulmonary infections
other: Reduced or absent FADD protein expression by flow cytometry or western blot

distinguishingFeatures: Mutations in FAS, FASLG, or CASP10 genes instead of FADD
Presence of autoimmune cytopenias with lymphoproliferation
Profound combined T- and B-cell immunodeficiency
Absence of Fas pathway apoptosis defects

redFlags: Early-onset severe recurrent bacterial and viral infections
Profound lymphopenia with impaired Fas-mediated apoptosis
Failure to respond to standard immunodeficiency treatments
references: Chun et al., 2017. FADD deficiency causes human immunodeficiency with defective Fas signaling. J Clin Invest.
Orphanet Report on FADD-related Immunodeficiency, ORPHA:306550.
Tang et al., 2019. Clinical and molecular features of FADD deficiency. Front Immunol.
